newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian woman kidnaps baby from maternity ward.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian woman kidnaps baby from maternity ward.

text.p: The parents of a 48-hour-old baby boy kidnapped from a Rio de Janeiro maternity ward made a tearful appeal to the kidnappers on national television on Monday
"The only thing we want is that the person who did this brings Rafael back," Giulio Zappa, 36, said on Globo television alongside his wife Constina de Souza Macedo Zappa, 22. "We won't do anything."

A hospital spokeswoman said a woman disguised as a nurse in a white uniform took the baby early on Sunday, telling the parents who were sleeping in the room next to him she was taking the boy to give him some glucose, the spokeswoman said.
She said the woman was thought to have left the hospital by taxi carrying the baby in a bag.
Police searched shantytowns in the area and alerted the airport, but to no avail.
